<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/uploads"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Allowed: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, heic, heif, mp4, mov, m4v, webm.
Max 200 MB per file, 10 files per request, 60 uploads per 10 minutes.
Pass the returned paths into `uploadedAssetUrls` when creating a post,
or into `avatarUrl` when updating your profile.
Photos and videos return stable future JPEG/MP4 paths plus small previews.
Full conversion runs in a persistent background queue. Posts can reference
queued media immediately; poll `/api/uploads/status/{assetKey}` until ready.
For clients without processing-status support, missing converted files
serve the original source while queued, processing or failed. HEIC/HEIF
uses the JPEG thumbnail when available, otherwise the original source.
Fallback responses use the source's Content-Type and Cache-Control: no-store;
video byte ranges are supported. Once available, the converted file is served.
